responsibility: Declares SubstituteCtx, the helper object responsible for replacing Rust macro transcriber tokens with matched invocation fragments. The class holds references to the input invocation token stream, the transcriber token stream, and the map of MatchedFragmentContainer captures, and it exposes the public operations for substituting metavariables, expanding repetitions, validating repetition counts, and producing the final substituted token vector consumed by MacroExpander transcription.
same_name_distinction: This header defines the SubstituteCtx class shape and public/private substitution API, along with the references it keeps to input tokens, transcriber tokens, and matched fragments. The matching .cc file implements the actual metavar and repetition expansion logic.
